description: High-end, dynamic dark mode for a nightlife events platform. Combines absolute darkness with saturated neon accents, glassmorphism, and smooth vanilla JavaScript micro-interactions to create tension, anticipation, and a premium nightclub feel.
target_environment: Python SSR Templates (HTML, pure CSS, vanilla JS inline script) - NO React/SPA.

headings.usage: H1, H2, large statistical numbers, primary CTAs. Must use tracking-tighter (letter-spacing: -0.04em) and tight line-height (leading-none).

body.usage: Paragraphs, tags, standard buttons, meta data. Use tracking-wide for uppercase labels.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-filter: blur(24px) with a 1px border of rgba(255,255,255,0.06). Never use pure transparent backgrounds over content.
visual_enhancers.ambient_glow: Create massive background blurred circles (filter: blur(120px)) in deep magenta and cyan, placed as fixed backgrounds with 15% opacity to break the pure black.
visual_enhancers.card_borders: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05). Add an inner shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1) for premium depth.
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Optionally apply a subtle SVG noise overlay (opacity: 0.03) to the body to remove digital flatness.

layouts.hero_section: Asymmetrical layout. Massive H1 on the left. On the right, a floating abstract composition of event posters or blurred neon orbs.
layouts.bento_grid: For statistics or 'FAQ/Benefits', use CSS Grid where items span different rows/columns. Provide generous gap (gap-6 or gap-8).
layouts.event_grid: Responsive grid: 1 col (mobile), 2 cols (tablet), 3 or 4 cols (desktop). Posters must have aspect-ratio 4/5 or 3/4.

motion.strategy: No React libraries. Pure CSS transitions for hover states, and Vanilla JS IntersectionObserver for scroll reveals.

scroll_reveal.css: .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); transition: opacity 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .reveal.active { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
scroll_reveal.js: const observer = new IntersectionObserver(e => e.forEach(entry => { if(entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('active'); observer.unobserve(entry.target); } }), { threshold: 0.1 }); document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

mouse_glow_cards.description: Radial gradient spotlight that follows the mouse cursor inside the card.
mouse_glow_cards.css: .glow-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #0E0E12; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .glow-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: var(--y, 50%); left: var(--x, 50%); width: 400px; height: 400px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,0,85,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s; pointer-events: none; z-index: 2; } .glow-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
mouse_glow_cards.js: document.querySelectorAll('.glow-card').forEach(card => card.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect(); card.style.setProperty('--x', (e.clientX - rect.left) + 'px'); card.style.setProperty('--y', (e.clientY - rect.top) + 'px'); }));

micro_interactions.button_hover: Scale up slightly (transform: scale(1.02)), increase box-shadow glow (box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,0,85,0.4)).

city_hero.layout: Min-height 70vh, flex column or grid. H1 size clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem).
city_hero.stats: Inline flex row with glassmorphism pills (backdrop-blur-md, bg-white/5, border-white/10).
city_hero.filters: Sticky tab bar right below hero. Active state gets a 2px bottom border in neon pink.

event_card.image_container: Border-radius 12px, overflow hidden, aspect-ratio 3/4. Include the blurred background fill trick we already have.
event_card.badges: Absolute positioned over the image (top-left for status, bottom-right for price). Use pure CSS pulse animation for 'A la venta'.
event_card.typography: Title in Unbounded (font-weight: 800, text-lg). Venue/Date in Outfit (text-sm, color: secondary).

event_detail_page.hero: Massive edge-to-edge poster with a heavy bottom gradient (to #050508) to blend into the content.
event_detail_page.meta_boxes: Grid of 3 items (Cuándo, Dónde, Precio). Glassmorphic background, glowing icons.
event_detail_page.sticky_buy_bar: Fixed bottom (bottom-0), z-index 50, glassmorphic (bg-black/80, blur-xl), border-t border-white/10. Contains Price and massive primary 'Comprar' button.

buttons.primary: Background: linear-gradient(90deg, #FF0055, #D40047). Color: White. Font: Unbounded bold. Border-radius: 9999px (pill). Padding: 12px 24px.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the design directly into the Python SSR templates in /app/backend/server.py.
Do NOT touch or create any React files. We are returning HTML strings from Python.
Update the _SEO_CSS constant with all the custom CSS (animations, custom variables, .reveal classes, .glow-card styles, typography font-face imports).
Append a <script> block at the end of the <body> in _render_home, _render_city, _render_event, etc., containing the Vanilla JS for IntersectionObserver and Mouse Move glow effects.
Implement the .reveal classes on elements (H1s, cards, paragraphs) with inline stagger delays (e.g., style='transition-delay: 100ms') to create beautiful cascading entrances.
Ensure SEO tags and JSON-LD stay perfectly intact. Design is purely visual layer (CSS classes + minimal structural HTML divs for layout).

universal_guidelines.spacing: Use 2x more padding/margin than usual. e.g., sections should have py-24 or py-32 equivalent.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure text over gradients/images has sufficient contrast (use text-shadow or gradient overlays). Maintain descriptive aria-labels on buttons.
universal_guidelines.testing: Add data-testid attributes to key structural elements (e.g., data-testid='event-card', data-testid='sticky-buy-bar') within the Python strings.
